Breakdown

How we calculate it: sunlight is NASA POWER's all-sky surface irradiance for your field (kWh/m² per day), raised 10% for tilted panels, with 80% system efficiency and 0.5% panel ageing a year. Electricity you use yourself is valued at your tariff; the rest at the export rate, both rising with the price-rise setting. Upkeep is 1% of the install cost a year, plus an inverter replacement (10%) in year 12. Crop losses use the profit per m² from your dashboard's year-round plan. Default costs per watt are typical 2025–26 farm-scale prices; edit them for your quote.

Code generated with Super Intelligence (SI): Claude by Anthropic, from the terra.pura team's designs. Data: NASA POWER · SoilGrids · Open-Meteo · OpenStreetMap · FAOSTAT. About & disclosure Privacy
